summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Office Inventory Rental (Gudang Kantor). Backend: 32/32 pytest cases pass covering auth, catalog, RBAC, full booking lifecycle (create->approve->access-generate->return-request->confirm-return), double-booking prevention, admin CRUD, settings, logs, rejection flow, maintenance-blocks-booking, and Telegram webhook (secret enforcement + approve callback). Frontend: user login, catalog search/filter, booking creation with access hidden while pending, admin approve visible after approval (access-card shows 6-digit code + Copy + Cara Membuka Gudang), Peminjaman Saya list, all 6 admin tabs (approval/peminjaman/akses/inventaris/log/pengaturan) load, settings save works, RBAC redirect for user visiting /admin. Everything integrates properly. Simulasi mode confirmed working (calendar SYNCED simulasi, provider code generated).

issues: Beberapa item pakai foto yang sama (Battery Sony NP-FW50, Tripod Manfrotto, Lighting Godox SL60 semua pakai gambar 'meja dengan miniatur'). Kualitas visual seed data bisa ditingkatkan agar tiap barang punya foto unik.

action_items: (opsional) Ganti URL foto seed items agar unik per barang (bukan blocker).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py::_check_lockout menggunakan `rec['last_attempt'].replace(tzinfo=rec['last_attempt'].tzinfo or None)` — jika Mongo mengembalikan datetime naive (tzinfo=None), pengurangan dengan now_utc (aware) akan raise TypeError. Saat ini tidak terpicu karena rec biasanya tidak mencapai count>=5 di test, tapi tetap perlu di-normalize aware.
server.py listing SEED_ITEMS: beberapa item share URL photo -> secara fungsional OK tapi UX seed data seragam.
Kode akses hanya ditampilkan setelah STATUS_PENDING lewat -> sudah benar (test_03_get_booking_pending_hides_access passing).
Route frontend menggunakan bahasa Indonesia (/peminjaman, /barang) -- konsisten dan bagus.
Semua endpoint /api sudah mengembalikan struktur ser() yang membuang _id; tidak ada ObjectId leak.
